required_calibration_input: independent upper bound sigma_squared on every normalized quadrature-mean single-trial variance
matrix_frobenius_radius: e=sqrt(72)*epsilon for each reconstructed complex 6x6 map
composition_residual_threshold: 2*e+e^2 under mutually inverse source-unitary forward/reverse null
decision_rule: Reject when either Frobenius residual exceeds its frozen threshold; retain an inconclusive guard band for independently bounded systematic bias.
physical_status: formula preregistered; numerical threshold unavailable until sigma_squared and systematic bias are measured before science outcomes
